maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from payment processing fees and bill-pay services on transactions, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Payments from consumers and businesses: lending, auto loans, healthcare, utilities billing via KUBRA; government is only a minor vertical.

serial_acquirer.reason: Several deals (BillingTree, Payix, cPayPlus, KUBRA) but growth is mainly from processing volume and integrations, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Payment processing embedded in clients' software and billing; switching requires re-integration and risks payment disruption.

notes: Acquisitions are notable, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgement call.
